scene: Evening after visarjan. An EMPTY low domestic shrine shelf with crimson cloth, wilting marigold garland and one small diya at far back; no Ganesha murti remains. Buddy gently leaves his squeaky bone on empty cloth, muzzle lowered and full body visible in three-quarter side view, attached neck and four supported paws. Neet lies in last pale window light beside him, front paws forward, eyes soft, full smooth tan torso and folded hindquarters shown. Quiet tenderness with Buddy continuing to host the absent guest. No funeral imagery or crying cartoon tears, no humans or text. Different from arrival image because shrine empty, garland wilted, evening light.
placement_after: Neet curled up in his usual sunbeam, Buddy dropped his squeaky toy in the shrine. Buddy left the toy there and settled beside Neet. Neither of them moved it when the house grew quiet.
